key_insight: AgentToolMO adds standardized cross-vendor trust visibility so autonomous network agents can stop using compromised tools quickly instead of continuing blind trust across vendor boundaries.
engineering_relevance: For 3GPP autonomous networks, it offers a practical management-layer mechanism to contain cascading failures without changing agent logic or relying on human oversight.
method: Defines a trust state machine with graduated enforcement actions.
Propagates trust changes through damped cascade rules with bounded convergence.
Uses existing MnS interfaces and NRM dependency graph traversal for notifications and impact assessment.
evidence_signal: Simulation results in multi-vendor topologies indicate near-real-time containment, bounded cascade convergence, and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains.
watch_item: Real-world adoption depends on vendors exposing compatible trust metadata and on notification latency staying low enough for the containment guarantees to hold.
paper_title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
